_comment: One-time setup by the skill author. DEFAULT mode reads a GitHub-hosted evidence snapshot (github.com is on the Cowork network allowlist). Set evidence_parquet_url to a public GitHub Release asset: a parquet exported from the Supabase mirassist_evidence_pairs table WITH the learned-score and precomputed percentile columns. The supabase_* fields are only used if you switch EVIDENCE_BACKEND=rest and your environment allowlists the Supabase host. End users set nothing. Env vars (MIRASSIST_EVIDENCE_URL, MIRASSIST_EVIDENCE, EVIDENCE_BACKEND, MIRASSIST_SUPABASE_URL, MIRASSIST_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, EVIDENCE_TABLE) override these.
